qualification.details: Research Associate I: Ph.D. in Geotechnical Engineering/Earthquake Engineering/Mining/Soil Dynamics from IIT/NITs/CFTIs or reputed institutions. PhD in one of the relevant areas- physical modelling/centrifuge modelling, or numerical modelling of blasts in soils, or dynamic loading. At least one research paper in Science Citation Indexed (SCI) or Q1/Q2 journal. JRF: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering (min CGPA 7.0/10 or 70%) and M.Tech. degree in Structural Engineering/Structural dynamics/Earthquake Engineering/Geotechnical Engineering (min CGPA 6.5/10 or 65%). GATE Qualified.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 58000/- per month + 10% HRA (Research Associate I), Rs. 37000/- per month for 2 years + 10% HRA, Rs. 42000/- per month for 3rd year + 10% HRA (JRF)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Roorkee Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIT Roorkee Research Associate I / JRF posts is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Associate I / JRF posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Research Associate I and JRF positions at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: For the JRF post, candidates need a B.Tech. in Civil Engineering with a minimum CGPA of 7.0/10 and an M.Tech. degree in Structural Engineering/Structural dynamics/Earthquake Engineering/Geotechnical Engineering with a minimum CGPA of 6.5/10, along with GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Research Associate I position?
faq.answer: The Research Associate I position offers a salary of Rs. 58000/- per month plus 10% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will involve an Online Interview conducted via Webex.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply for these positions through email.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The positions of Research Associate I and JRF are contractual in nature.

faq.question: Q9. Which department is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee).

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is SRIC/06.
